purpose: Nullsafe named reception checks invalid Throwable before body initialization and retains the native API trace, then valid send and supplied throw retain ordinary catch/finally behavior.
source:
<?php
class Stop110B extends Exception {}
function Flow110B() {
    global $stop;
    echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|';
    try { yield 'tail'; }
    catch (Stop110B $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|'; yield 'caught'; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    return 110;
}
$stop = new Stop110B(); $generator = Flow110B();
try { $generator?->throw(exception: 17); }
catch (TypeError $error) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo 'TYPE|', $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::throw(): Argument #1 ($exception) must be of type Throwable, int given', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'throw', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === 17, '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
    unset($trace, $error);
}
echo 'SEND|', $generator?->send(value: 41), '|';
echo 'THROW|', $generator?->throw(exception: $stop), '|';
$generator?->next(); echo 'RETURN|', $generator?->getReturn(), '|';
